expected_version.description: Copy the current version returned by a read. save_memory uses 0 only to create a missing name. Stale versions fail without overwriting.

reason.description: Brief explanation for the report or administrative action.

id.description: Resource ID from a prior response. For memory use your stable note name, e.g. working-context.
